title_en: Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate Supplementary Provisions (V) on the Determination of Charges in Implementing the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
April 27, 2011
Supreme People's Court Supreme People's Procuratorate
Supplementary Provisions on Determining Crimes for Enforcement of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (V)
Fa Shi [2011] No. 10
Pursuant to the provisions of Amendment VIII to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as "Amendment VIII to the Criminal Law"), the following supplements and amendments are hereby made to the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Determining Crimes for Enforcement of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China and the Opinions of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Names of Crimes under the Specific Provisions of the Criminal Law:
